title: Nuclide notation in a beta decay
caption: The mass number A (protons + neutrons) is written top left and the atomic number Z (protons) bottom left. In ¹⁴₆C → ¹⁴₇N + ⁰₋₁e a neutron becomes a proton: A stays 14 and Z rises from 6 to 7, so the element changes from carbon to nitrogen.
alt: Carbon-14 with 6 protons and 8 neutrons beside nitrogen-14 with 7 protons and 7 neutrons, each with its nuclide symbol.
description: Left: ¹⁴₆C, nucleus 6 p and 8 n, electrons 2, 4.
Right: ¹⁴₇N, nucleus 7 p and 7 n, electrons 2, 5.
Both have mass number 14; the atomic number has risen by one.
